query:
SELECT 
  data,
  ROUND(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8, 2) as cat1_8,
  ROUND(cat9, 2) as cat9,
  ROUND(cat1+cat2+cat3+cat4+cat5+cat6+cat7+cat8+cat9, 2) as total_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE empresaSlug = 'MORUMBI' AND mes = 3 AND ano = 2026
ORDER BY data ASC;
